get_config_parse_args: parse command line arguments and return a config object with all training and network settings
str2bool_convert: convert a string value to a boolean using the str2bool function
str2list_convert: convert a comma-separated string of integers to a list using str2list
str2opt_validate: validate and return an optimizer name (SGD or Adam) using str2opt
str2scheduler_validate: validate and return a learning rate scheduler name (StepLR, PolyLR, ExpLR, SquaredLR) using str2scheduler
